units.source_text: 几乎所有女人，即使胯下稍微打开一点，若不是在爱情故事的框子里，自己的价值得不到对方的承认，她就要想入非非了。

en.t: Almost every woman, even if she opens her thighs just a little, will start imagining things if, outside the frame of a love story, her own worth is not acknowledged by the other person.

units.source_text: 可是，这种令人同情的单纯错觉，实际上正是将女人转变为单方面精神强奸被害者的原因……

en.t: But this pitiful, simple illusion is in fact precisely what turns a woman into the victim of a one-sided spiritual violation...
